dialogue.text: September 5th, 1972.
dialogue.ja: 1972年9月5日です。
dialogue.local: September 5th, 1972.
dialogue.en: September 5th, 1972.

dialogue.text: They're all gone.
dialogue.zh: 他們全都不見了。
dialogue.ja: みんないなくなりました。
dialogue.local: They're all gone.
dialogue.en: They're all gone.

dialogue.text: The Israeli Olympic team's destroyed much of it, some of their officials.
dialogue.zh: 以色列奧運隊毀壞了大部分，還有他們的一些官員。
dialogue.ja: イスラエルのオリンピックチームが多くを破壊し、一部の役員も含まれていました。
dialogue.local: The Israeli Olympic team's destroyed much of it, some of their officials.
dialogue.en: The Israeli Olympic team's destroyed much of it, some of their officials.

dialogue.text: A massacre at the summer Olympic Games in Munich in what's then West Germany.
dialogue.zh: 當時位於西德的慕尼黑夏季奧運會發生了大屠殺。
dialogue.ja: 当時の西ドイツ、ミュンヘンでの夏季オリンピックで虐殺が起きました。
dialogue.local: A massacre at the summer Olympic Games in Munich in what's then West Germany.
dialogue.en: A massacre at the summer Olympic Games in Munich in what's then West Germany.

dialogue.text: Palestinian guerrillas attack the Israeli Olympic team killing two athletes in their rooms,
dialogue.zh: 巴勒斯坦游擊隊襲擊以色列奧運隊，殺害兩名運動員於他們的房間內，
dialogue.ja: パレスチナのゲリラがイスラエルのオリンピックチームを襲い、2人の選手を部屋で殺害しました。
dialogue.local: Palestinian guerrillas attack the Israeli Olympic team killing two athletes in their rooms,
dialogue.en: Palestinian guerrillas attack the Israeli Olympic team killing two athletes in their rooms,

dialogue.text: taking nine others hostage.
dialogue.zh: 並挾持另外九人作為人質。
dialogue.ja: さらに9人を人質に取りました。
dialogue.local: taking nine others hostage.
dialogue.en: taking nine others hostage.

dialogue.text: The nearly two-day standoff ends with a total of 11 Israelis, five of their attackers,
dialogue.zh: 這場近兩天的對峙結束時，共有11名以色列人、5名攻擊者，
dialogue.ja: ほぼ2日間の対立は、11人のイスラエル人と5人の襲撃者が死亡する結果となりました。
dialogue.local: The nearly two-day standoff ends with a total of 11 Israelis, five of their attackers,
dialogue.en: The nearly two-day standoff ends with a total of 11 Israelis, five of their attackers,

dialogue.text: and a police officer dead.
dialogue.zh: 以及一名警察死亡。
dialogue.ja: そして警察官1人も亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: and a police officer dead.
dialogue.en: and a police officer dead.

dialogue.text: In Sacramento, California,
dialogue.zh: 在加州薩克拉門托，
dialogue.ja: カリフォルニア州サクラメントで、
dialogue.local: In Sacramento, California,
dialogue.en: In Sacramento, California,

dialogue.text: President Gerald Ford escapes the first of two assassination attempts, just weeks apart.
dialogue.zh: 總統傑拉爾德·福特逃過兩次刺殺未遂中的第一次，兩次相隔僅數週。
dialogue.ja: ジェラルド・フォード大統領は、わずか数週間の間に起きた2回の暗殺未遂のうち最初のものを逃れました。
dialogue.local: President Gerald Ford escapes the first of two assassination attempts, just weeks apart.
dialogue.en: President Gerald Ford escapes the first of two assassination attempts, just weeks apart.

dialogue.text: AP correspondent Walter Rogers.
dialogue.zh: 美聯社記者沃爾特·羅傑斯報導。
dialogue.ja: AP通信のウォルター・ロジャース記者です。
dialogue.local: AP correspondent Walter Rogers.
dialogue.en: AP correspondent Walter Rogers.

dialogue.text: The woman came within three feet of the president,
dialogue.zh: 那名女子距離總統不到三英尺，
dialogue.ja: その女性は大統領から約1メートルの距離まで近づきましたが、
dialogue.local: The woman came within three feet of the president,
dialogue.en: The woman came within three feet of the president,

dialogue.text: but police and Mr. Ford's Secret Service agents wrestled her to the ground
dialogue.zh: 但警方和福特的特勤局特工將她摔倒在地，
dialogue.ja: しかし警察とフォード大統領のシークレットサービスのエージェントが彼女を取り押さえました。
dialogue.local: but police and Mr. Ford's Secret Service agents wrestled her to the ground
dialogue.en: but police and Mr. Ford's Secret Service agents wrestled her to the ground

dialogue.text: before she could get a shot off.
dialogue.zh: 在她開槍之前。
dialogue.ja: 彼女が発砲する前にです。
dialogue.local: before she could get a shot off.
dialogue.en: before she could get a shot off.

dialogue.text: Ford's would-be assassin Lynette Squeaky from a disciple of convicted murderer Charles Manson
dialogue.zh: 福特的未遂刺客萊妮特·斯奎基是被定罪殺人犯查爾斯·曼森的追隨者，
dialogue.ja: フォード大統領の暗殺未遂犯、ライネット・スキークは、有罪判決を受けた殺人犯チャールズ・マンソンの弟子でした。
dialogue.local: Ford's would-be assassin Lynette Squeaky from a disciple of convicted murderer Charles Manson
dialogue.en: Ford's would-be assassin Lynette Squeaky from a disciple of convicted murderer Charles Manson

dialogue.text: gets life behind bars.
dialogue.zh: 被判終身監禁。
dialogue.ja: 終身刑を受けました。
dialogue.local: gets life behind bars.
dialogue.en: gets life behind bars.

dialogue.text: Jack Kerouac's novel on the road a major work of the beat generation during the decade after
dialogue.zh: 傑克·凱魯亞克的小說《在路上》是二戰後十年中垮掉的一代的重要作品，
dialogue.ja: ジャック・ケルアックの小説『オン・ザ・ロード』は、第二次世界大戦後の10年間のビート世代の代表作です。
dialogue.local: Jack Kerouac's novel on the road a major work of the beat generation during the decade after
dialogue.en: Jack Kerouac's novel on the road a major work of the beat generation during the decade after

dialogue.text: World War II is first published.
dialogue.zh: 首次出版。
dialogue.ja: 初めて出版されました。
dialogue.local: World War II is first published.
dialogue.en: World War II is first published.

dialogue.text: during the joy of loving to start working,
dialogue.zh: 在愛的喜悅中開始工作，
dialogue.ja: 愛の喜びの中で働き始め、
dialogue.local: during the joy of loving to start working,
dialogue.en: during the joy of loving to start working,

dialogue.text: start loving the poor, start doing something, let the best way to remember.
dialogue.zh: 開始愛窮人，開始做些事情，讓這成為最好的紀念方式。
dialogue.ja: 貧しい人々を愛し始め、何かを始めること、それが最良の記憶の方法です。
dialogue.local: start loving the poor, start doing something, let the best way to remember.
dialogue.en: start loving the poor, start doing something, let the best way to remember.

dialogue.text: Mother Teresa, who received a Nobel Peace Prize for her work on behalf of the poor,
dialogue.zh: 特蕾莎修女因為她為窮人所做的工作而獲得諾貝爾和平獎，
dialogue.ja: 貧しい人々のための活動でノーベル平和賞を受賞したマザー・テレサは、
dialogue.local: Mother Teresa, who received a Nobel Peace Prize for her work on behalf of the poor,
dialogue.en: Mother Teresa, who received a Nobel Peace Prize for her work on behalf of the poor,

dialogue.text: dies in Calcutta, India.
dialogue.zh: 在印度加爾各答去世。
dialogue.ja: インドのカルカッタで亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: dies in Calcutta, India.
dialogue.en: dies in Calcutta, India.

dialogue.text: She was 87 years old.
dialogue.zh: 她享年87歲。
dialogue.ja: 享年87歳でした。
dialogue.local: She was 87 years old.
dialogue.en: She was 87 years old.

dialogue.text: Today in history, September 5th,
dialogue.zh: 今天的歷史，9月5日，
dialogue.ja: 今日の歴史、9月5日、
dialogue.local: Today in history, September 5th,
dialogue.en: Today in history, September 5th,

dialogue.text: Ross Simpson, the Associated Press.
dialogue.zh: 美聯社的羅斯·辛普森報導。
dialogue.ja: AP通信のロス・シンプソンです。
dialogue.local: Ross Simpson, the Associated Press.
dialogue.en: Ross Simpson, the Associated Press.
